PROTECTION OF COMMUNAL PROPERTIES OF MINORITIES COMMUNITIES RULES, 2003
PROTECTION OF COMMUNAL PROPERTIES OF MINORITIES COMMUNITIES RULES,
2003.
[Gazette. of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 19th February, 2004]
S.R.O.35(KE)/2004,dated 20-1-2004.---In exercise of the powers
conferred by section 7 of the Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities
Ordinance, 2002 (V of 2002), the Federal Government is pleased to make the
following rules, namely:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) These rules tray be called
the Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Communities Rules, 2003.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definition.--(1) In these Rules, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context,-
(a)
"Commission" means the National, Commission for Minorities set up by
the Ministry of Minorities, Culture, Sports, Toursim and Youth Affairs; and
(b)
"Government" means the Federal Government in the Ministry of
Minorities, Culture, Sports, Tourism and Youth Affairs.
3. Permission for sale or transfer of minority communities properties.--(1)
Any person intending to purchase, sell or transfer any property shall apply to
the Government, for the grant of N.O.C., giving all relevant detail of
particulars and information. Such person shall also provide any other
information or documents as may be required by the Government for processing of
his application.
Explanation.--For the purposes of this rule, the terms
"transfer" includes transfer by Way of lease or gift.
(2) The Government on receipt of
an application under sub-rule (1), shall invite objections through Press.
(3) The Government after
considering the application and objections if any, may give N.O.C. to the
applicant on recommendation of the Commission.
4. Eviction from unauthorized occupation and restoration of possession
of property to the lawful authorities/owners.--Where any person in
possession of the Property of a Church or Communal authority after retirement
or removal from service of such' Church or Communal authority,--
(a) retains the
possessions of such Property; or
(b) refuses to
vacate such Property; of
(c) uses such
property for any purpose for .which he is not authorized use;
he shall be liable to eviction in
accordance with the law for the time being in force.
